renewBefore.description: How long before expiry cert-manager begins attempting renewal

validity.description: Cluster intermediate CA validity duration (ISO 8601 duration string) Default: 90 days. Short-lived; cert-manager renews automatically.

validationFailureAction.description: Kyverno validationFailureAction for pki-namespace-ca-chain-of-custody. Audit only: do not set to Enforce until pki-platform#353 confirms the backfill is clean across all 5 PKI-managed namespaces; the flip itself is a separate, explicit decision.

label.description: Namespace-scoped intermediate CA generation (Certificate + Issuer) for any namespace carrying the label below, plus chain-of-custody enforcement.

renewBefore.description: How long before expiry cert-manager begins attempting renewal

validity.description: Namespace intermediate CA validity duration (ISO 8601 duration string). Default: 90 days, matching pki.intermediateCA. Short-lived; cert-manager renews automatically.

validationFailureAction.description: Kyverno validationFailureAction for pki-deny-staging-configmap-mount. Audit: log violations without blocking (safe default for rollout). Enforce: block pods that mount the staging trust-anchor ConfigMap.

enabled.description: Deploy Kyverno audit ClusterPolicies for PKI compliance observability. Requires Kyverno to be installed in the cluster.

renewBefore.description: How long before expiry cert-manager begins attempting renewal

validity.description: Root CA certificate validity duration (ISO 8601 duration string) Default: 2 years. Root lives online in a Kubernetes Secret and renews automatically — shorter validity bounds blast radius without any operational cost.

enabled.description: Deploy the private-intermediate-ca trust-manager Bundle. When true, trust-manager distributes the intermediate CA certificate to all namespaces as a ConfigMap (key: ca.crt). Note: the private-root-ca Bundle is operator-managed (not chart-managed).
